description: Buy, sell or rent a flat in Kothrud with a local team whose head office is at Karve Statue. Resale flats, redevelopment and new projects.
card: Our head office is here, at Karve Statue. Resale flats, redevelopment and new projects.
about: Kothrud is one of west Pune's largest and most settled residential areas, popular with families for its schools, hospitals, parks and the Vanaz–Ramwadi metro line. Neighbourhoods such as Mayur Colony, Dahanukar Colony, Ideal Colony and Karve Road each have their own character and price levels.

Much of Kothrud's housing is in older cooperative societies, many of which are now being redeveloped. That creates opportunities for buyers and sellers, and makes document checks and redevelopment terms especially important.
Our head office is at Karve Statue, so we know these lanes, societies and recent deals first-hand.

help.sell: Pricing based on recent deals in your society, with buyers already looking in Kothrud.
help.rent: Verified tenants for landlords, and family-friendly rentals near schools and the metro.

about: Karvenagar sits just south of Kothrud and is known as a quieter, greener residential neighbourhood, with easy access to Kothrud, Warje and Sinhagad Road.
It has a mix of older societies, independent homes and newer buildings, which suits families who want space without moving far from Kothrud's schools and markets.
Because it's minutes from our office, we can arrange visits at short notice.

about: Prabhat Road is one of central Pune's most sought-after addresses, close to Deccan Gymkhana, Law College Road and FC Road.
Its tree-lined lanes have older bungalows, low-rise buildings and newer premium flats, many from redevelopment, and good homes here rarely stay on the market for long.
Sellers often prefer a quiet approach to known buyers. We handle that discreetly, and help buyers act quickly when the right home appears.
